_note: The REAL StyleSheet numbers for the Pairing Manager. Spec §1.2–1.6 prose is secondary; where they disagree the deviation is recorded in PORTING_NOTES.md.

shareCard._note: The share card is captured off-screen at `left: -9999` and rasterised at `SHARE_CARD_WIDTH * PixelRatio.get()`. The WIDTH is the design constant; the pixel ratio is the device. Only the former belongs in the metrics layer.

headers._note: Spec §1.2/§1.3 say `h 16 / v 12` and §1.4 says `h 16 / v 10`. There is no shared header component — 2 distinct shapes across 3 screens. Encode per screen.

palette._note: Every colour literal in the four StyleSheets (three screens, plus the share card), by use count.

delays._note: Every setTimeout/setInterval with a literal delay. In this feature they are the waits before capturing the off-screen share card — the only timing the Pairing Manager has.

lines.text: pairings.map(p => { if (p.is_bye) { return `Bd ${p.board_number}: ${p.white_player?.name ?? '?'} — BYE`; } const resultStr = p.result === 'pending' ? 'vs' : p.result === '1-0' ? '1-0' : p.result === '0-1' ? '0-1' : '½-½'; return `Bd ${p.board_number}: ${p.white_player?.name ?? '?'} ${resultStr} ${p.black_player?.name ?? '?'}`; })

terms.text: pairings.map(p => { if (p.is_bye) { return `Bd ${p.board_number}: ${p.white_player?.name ?? '?'} — BYE`; } const resultStr = p.result === 'pending' ? 'vs' : p.result === '1-0' ? '1-0' : p.result === '0-1' ? '0-1' : '½-½'; return `Bd ${p.board_number}: ${p.white_player?.name ?? '?'} ${resultStr} ${p.black_player?.name ?? '?'}`; })

sorted.text: [...tournament.players].sort((a, b) => { if (b.score !== a.score) return b.score - a.score; if (b.buchholz !== a.buchholz) return b.buchholz - a.buchholz; if (b.sonneborn_berger !== a.sonneborn_berger) return b.sonneborn_berger - a.sonneborn_berger; return b.wins - a.wins; })

terms.text: [...tournament.players].sort((a, b) => { if (b.score !== a.score) return b.score - a.score; if (b.buchholz !== a.buchholz) return b.buchholz - a.buchholz; if (b.sonneborn_berger !== a.sonneborn_berger) return b.sonneborn_berger - a.sonneborn_berger; return b.wins - a.wins; })

lines.text: sorted.map((p, idx) => { const rank = String(idx + 1).padStart(2, ' '); const score = p.score % 1 === 0 ? `${p.score}.0` : `${p.score}`; return `${rank}. ${p.name} ${score} ${p.wins}W ${p.draws}D ${p.losses}L`; })

terms.text: sorted.map((p, idx) => { const rank = String(idx + 1).padStart(2, ' '); const score = p.score % 1 === 0 ? `${p.score}.0` : `${p.score}`; return `${rank}. ${p.name} ${score} ${p.wins}W ${p.draws}D ${p.losses}L`; })
